festival_name: Sri Swamy Vari Varshika Kalyana Mahotsavam (Brahmotsavaalu)
month: Vaisakha Suddha Dasami to Vaisakha Purnima (April–May)
importance: The crown of all annual festivals celebrated for 6 days with grand celestial marriage, cultural programs, processions, and vahana sevas.
description: Formerly performed on Magha Suddha Ekadasi, now celebrated for six days commencing from Vaisakha Suddha Dasami/Ekadasi to suit pilgrims. Lord Sri Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Swamy is wedded to Goddess Sri Anantha Lakshmi Ammavaru in the divine presence of Lord Sri Seeta Ramachandra Swamy.

schedule.details: Making up Sri Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Swamy as bridegroom; Vighneswara puja, giving vayanams to muthaiduvas; in the night Lord Sri Rama and Goddess Sita go out into the village on silver Anjaneya Vahanam to invite devotees and pilgrims to witness the Kalyana Mahotsavam.
Sri Swamy Vari Divya Kalyanam performed in the divine presence of Lord Sri Seeta Ramalu Varu with grand rituals.
Pradhana Sthalipaka Homam, followed by Arundhathi Nakshatra Darshan, Asthanaseva, and night procession on Ravana Vahanam.
Sri Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Swamy's Kalyanasadasyam, Sri Rama Sabhapathi, Panditasabha, Mahadasirvadam, Sabhasathkaram, and night procession on Ponna Vahanam.
Lord's Viharam in the garden on the north of Ratnagiri and return to Ratnagiri, Mahanivedana, special Veena performance in the presence of the Lord, and Car Festival (Rathotsavam) at night.
Chakra Teertham (holy bath), Nakabali, and Sri Swamy Vari Sri Pushpayaga Mahotsavam concluding the Brahmotsavam.

importance: The divine advent and discovery day of Lord Satyadeva celebrated as the Lord's birthday with great eclat.
description: Celebrates the self-manifestation and installation of Lord Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Swamy on Ratnagiri hill (originally installed on Sravana Suddha Vidiya of Khara year, 1891 AD). Special poojas, abhishekam, and festivities are conducted.

importance: Circumambulation of Ratnagiri hill and sacred bonfire ritual attracting thousands of devotees.
description: Mass circumambulation of Ratnagiri hill along with lighting of the sacred Jwala Toranam on Karthika Pournami night.

importance: Colourful floating boat festival celebrated on the waters of the Pampa River.
description: The utsava deities of Lord Satyadeva and Ammavaru are taken out in a colorfully illuminated boat on the Pampa River touching the foot of Ratnagiri.

importance: Nine nights of divine mother worship followed by Jammi Pooja on Vijaya Dasami.
description: Mahanyasa Abhishekam and Laksha Kumkumarchana are performed at the Yantralayam during Navaratri, concluding with Jammi Pooja on Vijaya Dasami.

importance: Grand night-long worship emphasizing the Hari-Hara synthesis of Lord Satyadeva.
description: Mahanyasa Poorvaka Abhishekam and Laksha Bilwarchana are performed with great devotion in the Main Temple.

importance: Celebration of Sri Sitarama Kalyanotsavam at the Sri Ramalayam.
description: Sri Sitarama Kalyanotsavams are performed in the adjoining Ramalayam for the Kshetra Palaka Lord Rama.

festival_name: Sri Kanaka Durgamma Vari Jatara Mahotsavams
importance: Annual jatara festival dedicated to Goddess Kanaka Durga.
description: Special rustic rituals, offerings, and processions conducted at the Sri Kanaka Durga temple.

importance: Telugu New Year festival featuring traditional Panchangasravanam.
description: Panchangasravanam and special prayers are performed for universal prosperity.

importance: Worship of Goddess Saraswathi for students and learning.
description: Special Sri Saraswathi Pooja performed on 1st April.

importance: Celebration of Lord Krishna's birth with Utla Sambaram.
description: Utla Sambaram (pot breaking festival) and joyous rituals are conducted.
Grand Ganapathi Navaratri Utsavams celebrated in the temple complex and Yantralayam.

importance: Festival of lights celebrated with temple illumination.
description: Deepotsavam and lighting of thousands of oil lamps around the temple on Ratnagiri hill.

importance: Traditional chariot/prabha procession in the village.
description: Prabha Utsavam will be conducted with decorated arches in the village.

importance: Village deity processions during the auspicious month of Dhanurmasam.
description: Grama sevas are conducted on every Ekadasi day throughout Dhanur Masam.
